audit.method: Direct model translation followed by a complete source-target editorial reading of both branches of Alex’s conversation with Dusty about his parents, childhood, and grandparents. Every spoken line, player response, family-history detail, abuse reference, trust statement, resilience theme, dog name, steak joke, and repeated branch was reviewed in full event context against the canonical Ukrainian glossary. Event commands, actors, movement, timing, fork destination, placeholders, dialogue delimiters, emotion markers, music and sound IDs, and all non-text payloads were preserved and structurally compared with English. Remaining Town records and full-locale final audits remain pending.
